assertions.subject: Cyanotic Congenital Heart Disease
assertions.quote: Cyanotic congenital heart disease occurs when some of the systemic venous return crosses from the right side of the heart to the left and returns to the body without going through the lungs

assertions.subject: Cyanotic Congenital Heart Disease
assertions.quote: Cyanosis, the visible sign of this shunt, occurs when approximately 5 g/100 mL of reduced hemoglobin is present in systemic blood
